name: zsnd_stream_request_state_begin_group
description: zSndStreamRequest::StateBeginGroup resets stream request state, selects the first group entry, and transitions to play or finished state.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage includes both empty-group completion and queue-driven playable-entry selection.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x4a4cb0 validates elapsed/play-index reset, current-entry clear, empty-group finished state, SelectWeightedEntry call, and state 1 versus state 4 transition.
The native smoke verifies reset behavior for an empty group and verifies queue-created requests transition to the selected playable entry.
